notes.title: Patch 1.2.2 Now Available - Adjustments and Fixes
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38915152/8464c22eda1e8ac4e51e4ac277006a7490416cd2.png"]

Hello, builder community!



With our ongoing dedication to improving the experience for all players of Diorama Builder and its DLCs, today we are releasing a new patch with several improvements and bug fixes.



Check out the full list:

Implemented new post-processing to improve the game's overall lighting.

Improved the lighting in specific dioramas like "Merry Christmas" and "Mars Colony," which were too bright on some monitor settings.

Fixed a bug where the achievement for completing one of a diorama's folders would only unlock after placing the next piece.

Resolved an issue with the command bar displaying incorrectly when switching from a diorama under construction (base game) to an already completed DLC.

Decreased the transparency of the placement meshes (gray and white) for better visibility of the pieces.

Adjusted the default mouse wheel sensitivity for a smoother zoom in/out experience.

Modified the system so that the main menu will always return to "Day" mode when exiting a diorama.

Removed the seam line between the tabs and retractable UI windows for a cleaner look.

Solution for several other minor bugs.



We also want to thank everyone for your continued support and excellent participation in our Steam community. Please keep sending your valuable feedback; it is very important to us!



Follow our studio page to be notified about new DLCs, updates, and future games.



Happy building!

notes.title: Big News in Diorama Builder: Now Available in Simplified Chinese!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38915152/9984b2a6547f098d3001d91befa0064f59e24fbe.png

Virtual Arts Studio is thrilled to announce that Diorama Builder and all its DLCs are now available in Simplified Chinese! 🎉

With this update, we aim to bring the magic of Diorama Builder to even more players around the world. 

Knowing how much the gaming community in China values immersive and creative experiences like Diorama Builder, we have worked hard to adapt every aspect of the game to ensure everyone can fully enjoy assembling unique and relaxing dioramas.

For those who are new to Diorama Builder, here’s what you’ll find:

 Detailed and lively constructions.
 Relaxing and thematic ambient music, perfect for immersing yourself in the assembly process.
 Interactions with amazing animations once each diorama is completed.
 Exciting themes such as Old West, Crime Scene, Asian Home, Egyptian Temple, etc.
 Plus, incredible DLCs, such as:

 Noir City 🕵️‍♂️: Uncover the mysteries of a noir city.
 Medieval Castle 🏰: Rebuild an epic castle.
 Mars Colony 🚀: Explore a futuristic colony on Mars.
 Secret Bunker 🔐: Discover the secrets of an underground shelter.
If you already own the game or any of its DLCs, the language update will be added automatically!

Don’t forget to like our page and follow us for more updates and news.

Happy building and have fun!

notes.title: RELEASE date announcement + super pre-launch DISCOUNT for Diorama Builder
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38915152/9b1124ee0d5c8688d9e79686fa2a76c0f81cc649.png

Hello fellow Diorama builders

The wait is almost over - the release of the final version of "Diorama Builder" arrives on June 20, 2024! Mark your calendars and get ready to dive into an even more complete diorama-building experience, including the 3 DLCs that will be released on the same day.

SUPER DISCOUNT OF 60% PRE-LAUNCH OF "DIORAMA BUILDER"

For those who are POSTPONING the purchase of DIORAMA BUILDER and in the name of transparency, we will be increasing the price for the LAUNCH of the FINAL VERSION, so to encourage them, between the 13th and 19th of May 2024, we will give a super discount of 60%!

>>> Don't miss this opportunity, BUY Diorama Builder now! <<<

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1370170/Diorama_Builder/

WHAT'S NEW IN THE FINAL VERSION?

We've been working hard to polish and perfect Diorama Builder, and we're excited to reveal a host of new features and improvements in the final release:

 Catalog of native dioramas and DLCs
Easily browse and manage your collection of dioramas (including the DLCs).

 Shelf organization system
Keep your diorama shelf organized and stocked with the dioramas you like most and are currently assembling.

 Stamps to divide the different dioramas into categories
Presentation of a SEAL for each diorama, determining its series for better identification.

 Axis visual system for better camera control
A new system to locate the center of the XYZ axes and thus be able to have greater control of the camera (rotation and zoom) at the desired point or object.

 Option to hide/show Diorama pieces from any folder
Turn on/off the visibility of diorama folders (parts) for a more focused view.

 New system for going down and up certain walls (for dioramas with this feature)
Move down and up certain walls of the dioramas with this feature, in a simpler and more intuitive way, to better appreciate the diorama's internal spaces.

 News feed
Stay up to date on the latest news and announcements from Diorama Builder.

 Improved help system
Find assistance quickly and easily with the improved help system.

 Visual, UI, and UX improvements
Experience improved visuals and a smoother, more intuitive user experience.

 Performance Improvements
Enjoy more stable and responsive gameplay.

ABOUT THE DLCS

Expand your diorama collection with the DLCs that will come out with the final version.
Don't leave it for later, add them to your WISHLIST now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2777580/Diorama_Builder__Noir_City/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2668590/Diorama_Builder__Medieval_Castle/

NEW DLC TO BE ANNOUNCED SOON AND RELEASED TOGETHER WITH THE FINAL VERSION OF THE GAME
Thank you and follow our page to stay up to date with upcoming announcements and news!
https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/virtualartsstudio


All the best, to everyone, always!

notes.title: Play "Diorama Builder" in AUGMENTED REALITY!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38915152/d2869938f53a7438727064f73c914640e71ca193.png

Today we are proud to announce the release of our game "Diorama Builder" to be played on Tilt Five™'s amazing Augmented Reality platform!

Really feel like you are putting together a virtual Diorama, piece by piece, as if it were there in front of you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38915152/aa51e1ea024f62f26940472fbe4330abccee9fca.gif

For the Tilt Five™ system, modifications designed to improve immersion in the game have been added, including:


 Navigate the Diorama using the Tilt Five™ wand, with full control of the scenery view, rotating, zooming and panning;
 The fourth, which is the game's MENU, was positioned below the Tilt Five™ board, giving the feeling of interacting with a model and choosing options on the objects inside it;
 After finishing the Dioramas, interact with the Tilt Five™ wand on some objects in the scenery and watch them animate and come to life.
IMPORTANT:

To explore these optional features, a Tilt Five™ system is required (available for Windows OS).

The classic "Diorama Builder" desktop gameplay is still available for everyone (Windows and macOS).

To learn more about Tilt Five™, visit https://www.tiltfive.com

notes.title: "The Awakening of Mummies" is available now!
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020302/abf4d0d3b36f9a54fb66d897c950fb75394997c4.png

Hi friends,

We are proudly launching yet another game, a game designed to amuse and challenge your logical and visual reasoning.

Using your puzzle-solving skills, guide all mummies through various chambers full of traps to finally set them free from the evil Pharaoh Cléo.

How to help these Mummies escape:

 Control all the Mummies together, that is, by moving them in a certain direction, they all will too.
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020302/f28396c90f914751e462b2897eeed8778959d9b5.gif

 Make sure that each mummy takes the corresponding staff before going to the Totem of the same color, as this is the only way the Portal will open.
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020302/076b405dc5cfaa90cfc1ec351d6af37af6d53826.gif

 Take care with:


 Holes: It is death for sure.
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020302/f1f75a6e9455d2e938370a25b1a83b3b8d836cba.gif

 Spears: It is not good to be pricked!
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35020302/3b4959149553e2f47df67a3b4cece323d8762df7.gif


 Keep an eye:


 Broken Floor: Nothing can happen, but be careful!
 Magic Mist: Get the crown, otherwise the cumin will be uncertain and the end almost certain.
 Mud: She will delay you, but it can help you.


Play it NOW...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1593410/The_Awakening_of_Mummies/

... and FOLLOW US on Steam to keep up to date with our releases!

https://store.steampowered.com/curator/35020302-Virtual-Arts-Studio/
